summary: Three citizenship routes that work through discretion or the nationality law rather than a branded programme. Cambodia's Law on Nationality has offered citizenship for investment or donation since 1996 (1.25 bn / 1 bn riel); the 2018 law moved the amounts into a sub-decree, and a sub-decree of 1 Dec 2025 raised them to 4 bn / 12 bn riel. The only counts are journalists' tallies of the Royal Gazette (all routes), which stopped publishing in Feb 2024. North Macedonia's Art. 11 'special economic interest' route has had fixed thresholds since Dec 2012 (EUR 400,000 + 10 jobs; a EUR 200,000 fund route since Dec 2019), with 121 grants 2005-2022 and one or two a year since, and the EU now demands abolition. Austria's StbG § 10(6) has no price or published economic criteria; Statistik Austria counts 10-54 grants a year (all fields), and the Carinthian cases of 2007-2012 are the documented abuses.

sources.title: Verordnung der Bundesregierung über das Verfahren zur Erlangung einer Bestätigung gemäß § 10 Abs. 6 des Staatsbürgerschaftsgesetzes 1985, BGBl. II Nr. 39/2014

sources.covers: Procedure for § 10(6) confirmations: the Land government forwards the file to the Interior Minister; the competent federal ministers give reasoned opinions; the federal government decides at least once every half-year.

sources.title: Уредба за изменување на Уредбата за утврдување на критериумите за особен ... национален интерес за стекнување на државјанство, Службен весник на РСМ бр. 255/2019

sources.title: Criminals May Benefit As Cambodia Hides New Citizenship Data
sources.publisher: Organized Crime and Corruption Reporting Project (OCCRP)

sources.title: How Cambodia Became A Haven For Criminals

events.title: Naturalisation in the interest of the state exists since the 1965 Citizenship Act
events.description: The Interior Ministry states that § 10(6) StbG (naturalisation in the interest of the state, keeping the previous nationality) has existed as a constitutional provision since the Citizenship Act 1965.
events.quote: der als Verfassungsbestimmung bereits seit dem Staatsbürgerschafts-gesetz 1965 existiert

events.title: Cabinet confirms citizenship for two Russian businessmen backed by Haider
events.description: On the basis of a Council of Ministers decision of January 2007, two Russian-born businessmen were naturalised after Carinthian governor Jörg Haider intervened with the Chancellor. Prosecutors alleged that their payments, EUR 1.9 million in total according to the indictment and largely used to sponsor a Carinthian Formula 1 driver, bought the citizenship; the defendants were acquitted in 2011 and again in 2013.
events.quote: Auf Basis eines Ministerratsbeschlusses vom Jänner 2007 wurde den beiden Geschäftsleuten die Staatsbürgerschaft verliehen

events.title: Cabinet rejects Carinthia's request to naturalise three Russian hotel investors
events.description: A week after the Carinthian government approved subsidies for the 'Tibet' hotel project, the Council of Ministers refused the Land's request to naturalise three Russian businessmen planning to invest EUR 6 million; the Interior Minister had vetoed it.
events.quote: eine Woche später lehnte der Ministerrat den Antrag auf Einbürgerung ab

events.title: 'Part of the Game': Carinthian deputy governor Scheuch convicted
events.description: Uwe Scheuch was convicted for having held out Austrian citizenship to a Russian investor in a recorded 2009 conversation in return for a party donation of 5-10% of the investment; 18 months, six of them unsuspended. The Graz Higher Regional Court later quashed this verdict for a procedural error and ordered a retrial.
events.quote: Im ersten Prozess war Scheuch am 2. August des Vorjahres zu 18 Monaten Haft, sechs davon unbedingt, verurteilt worden

events.title: Prosecutors: Russian investors paid twice before naturalisation
events.description: The anti-corruption prosecutors confirmed that two Russian investors who had since received Austrian citizenship paid a total of USD 2 million and EUR 900,000: the dollars for the Formula 1 career of a Carinthian driver, the second payment apparently for Haider or his party. Haider's former protocol chief was charged with money laundering; the payers and a lawyer were also charged.
events.quote: zahlten dafür insgesamt zwei Millionen Dollar und 900.000 Euro

events.title: 'Part of the Game': final verdict against Scheuch
events.description: The Graz Higher Regional Court upheld the conviction on appeal: seven months suspended and a fine of EUR 67,500 (the Klagenfurt retrial on 6 July 2012 had imposed EUR 150,000).
events.quote: Scheuch erhielt sieben Monate bedingte Haft und eine deutlich niedrigere Geldstrafe von 67.500 Euro

events.title: Acquittals in the trial over the 2007 naturalisations of two Russians
events.description: The Vienna criminal court acquitted Haider's former protocol chief (money laundering) and the two Russian-born businessmen and their lawyer (bribery), finding no proven link between the payments and the grant of citizenship. Not final at the time.
events.quote: keinen konkreten Konnex zwischen den Zahlungen und der Verleihung der Staatsbürgerschaft

events.title: Regulation on the § 10(6) confirmation procedure
events.description: Federal government regulation sets the procedure: Land governments forward files to the Interior Ministry, competent ministers give reasoned opinions, and the government decides at least once every half-year. No economic thresholds.
events.quote: jedenfalls einmal im Kalenderhalbjahr über die Erteilung oder die Nichterteilung einer Bestätigung

events.title: Minister: only names and professions of confirmed persons are published
events.description: Answering a parliamentary question on secrecy, the Interior Minister says the names and professions of persons for whom the federal government has confirmed a special interest (links given for confirmations since 1 January 2017) are published by the Federal Chancellery, and that nothing further (reasons, supporters, ministries' opinions, rejections) will be published. Forum Informationsfreiheit says names were published online for 2016 and 2017.
events.quote: Unter folgenden Links sind die Namen und Berufe jener Personen einsehbar

events.title: Transparency NGO challenges secrecy of § 10(6) grants
events.description: Forum Informationsfreiheit reported that the Interior Ministry had refused its request for the names of 2014-2015 grantees, including those naturalised for 'economic achievements'.
events.quote: Die Auskunft wurde uns mit Verweis auf Amtsgeheimnis und Datenschutz verweigert

events.title: Law on Citizenship allows exceptional naturalisation for special interest
events.description: Art. 11 of the 1992 Law on Citizenship allows an adult foreigner to be naturalised without the usual conditions where this is of special scientific, economic, cultural or national interest, with the Government's prior opinion.

events.title: Art. 11 amended; Government to set criteria by decree
events.description: The 2004 amendment rewrites Art. 11(1) (adding sport and 'other national interest') and requires the Government to set the criteria by decree.
events.quote: Владата на Република Македонија со уредба ќе ги

events.title: First decree on criteria for special interest
events.description: Government decree defines special economic interest broadly (direct investment, donation, securities, shares, know-how, innovation, new technologies) with no minimum amount; assessed by the Ministries of Economy and Finance. In force the day after publication on 9 Feb 2005.

events.description: Decree amendment of 6 Dec 2012 makes the main economic-interest criterion EUR 400,000 per person of direct investment in new capacity with at least 10 permanent jobs for a year. The European Commission dates the investor scheme to this December 2012 change.

events.title: Sons of Indian tycoon Subrata Roy naturalised
events.description: In 2013 the sons of Indian businessman Subrata Roy, presented by the then prime minister as major investors on the Ohrid shore, received Macedonian citizenship; Roy was arrested in India shortly after and the investments never materialised, but the family kept the documents.

events.title: Reza Zarrab obtained Macedonian citizenship and passport
events.description: Iranian-Turkish gold trader Reza Zarrab, arrested in the US in 2016 over Iran sanctions evasion, had been granted citizenship under Art. 11 under the name Riza Saraf; he applied on 2 Oct 2015 and the passport was issued on 29 Oct 2015, signed off by the then interior minister. Sources told Makfax that the Finance Ministry's opinion was negative.

events.title: EUR 200,000 investment-fund route added
events.description: Decree amendment of 10 Dec 2019 adds a route of at least EUR 200,000 per person for two years in a qualifying private investment fund.

events.title: Innovation Fund to adopt rulebook and fee for economic-interest assessments
events.description: Decree amendment of 16 Feb 2021 adds a scientific-interest criterion and requires the Fund for Innovation and Technology Development to adopt, with Government consent, a rulebook on assessing special economic interest and a fee tariff. In force on the eighth day after publication on 19 Feb 2021.
events.quote: Фондот за иновации и технолошки развој ќе доне

events.title: Government annuls citizenship granted for sporting interest
events.description: The Government annulled the citizenship granted on 31 May 2022 to Oleksandr Onyshchenko (on the equestrian federation's initiative) after reports that he was wanted in Ukraine and on a US blacklist; the only Art. 11 revocation reported by the Interior Ministry.

events.title: EU screening report: refrain from systematic investor citizenship

events.title: Law on Nationality creates investment and donation routes
events.description: The 1996 Law on Nationality waives the 7-year residence requirement for investors spending 1,250,000,000 riels (Arts 10-11) and lets donors of 1,000,000,000 riels to the national budget apply (Art. 12); grants by Royal Decree; applicants may take a Khmer name.

events.title: New Law on Nationality delegates amounts to sub-decree

events.title: Singapore money-laundering arrests expose Cambodian passports
events.description: Nine of the ten foreigners arrested in Singapore's money-laundering case in August 2023 held Cambodian passports; all ten were originally from China. Afterwards Cambodia granted far fewer citizenships and later stopped publishing them.
events.quote: Nine of the 10 foreigners arrested in August 2023 in the money laundering probe in Singapore held Cambodian passports.

events.title: Cambodia stops publishing naturalisations in the Royal Gazette

programs.name: Austrian citizenship in the special interest of the Republic (Staatsbürgerschaftsgesetz 1985, § 10 Abs. 6, 'außerordentliche Leistungen')
programs.notes: Not an advertised investment programme and no published price. A constitutional provision lets a Land grant citizenship without 10 years' residence, proof of income or renunciation of the old nationality when the federal government confirms that the person's past and expected 'extraordinary achievements' are in the special interest of the Republic. Used for scientists, artists, athletes and business people alike; official statistics do not split by field. Procedure regulated by BGBl. II 39/2014. Names and professions of confirmed persons are published (at least since 2016-2017). Statistik Austria counts 10 to 54 naturalisations a year in 2007-2023. The European Commission (COM(2019) 12, p. 4, fn. 10) lists Austria among states whose law equates national interest with economic interest. The 1965 start date comes from a ministry statement (8483/AB).

programs.name: North Macedonia: naturalisation for special economic interest (Закон за државјанството, член 11; Уредба за утврдување на критериумите за особен ... национален интерес)
programs.notes: Art. 11 of the Law on Citizenship (since 1992; reworded 2004) allows naturalisation without residence where it is of special scientific, economic, cultural, sporting or other national interest; the Government decides. Criteria decree of 2005 (no amounts); EUR 400,000 direct investment plus 10 jobs from 20 Dec 2012; EUR 200,000 private investment fund route added 14 Dec 2019. The Ministries of Finance and Economy assess economic interest and the security agency vets. 121 economic-interest grants 2005-2022 (40 refusals); one or two a year since. The European Commission (Dec 2025) says the scheme must be abolished under the Visa Suspension Mechanism; a June 2026 draft law would remove fixed amounts but keep investment as a criterion. This row covers the economic-interest route; some observations give other Art. 11 grounds (sport, culture, science) via breakdown. 'launched' is the first criteria decree; the legal basis dates from 1992.

programs.name: Cambodia: naturalisation by investment or donation (Law on Nationality 1996, Arts 10-12; Law on Nationality 2018, Arts 21-22; Sub-decree No. 225 of 2025)
programs.notes: Under the 1996 law, investors spending 1,250,000,000 riels were exempted from the 7-year residence requirement and donors of 1,000,000,000 riels to the national budget could apply; granted by Royal Decree, with an optional Khmer name. The 2018 law moved the amounts into a sub-decree (No. 112 of 30 Aug 2018, not found) and added 12 months' (investors) or 6 months' (donors) legal residence. Sub-decree No. 225 of 1 Dec 2025 sets 4,000,000,000 riel (investment in priority sectors) and 12,000,000,000 riel (donation). Naturalisations were published in the Royal Gazette until February 2024 (about 50 a month in 2020-2023, all routes); no official count by route. Several naturalised China-born businessmen were later sanctioned or prosecuted abroad.

new_indicators.name: Government confirmations of special interest
new_indicators.definition: Decisions by a national government or cabinet confirming that naturalising a named applicant is in the state's special (national or economic) interest, where such a confirmation is a precondition for a discretionary naturalisation granted later by another authority (e.g. Austria StbG § 10(6)). Counts confirmations in a period, not completed naturalisations.
new_indicators.notes: Austria: 'Bestätigungen gemäß § 10 Abs. 6 StbG durch die Bundesregierung'. Usually differs from persons_naturalised for the same year because of timing and family extensions.

new_indicators.name: Special-interest applications put before the cabinet
new_indicators.definition: Applications for discretionary special-interest naturalisation submitted to the cabinet (council of ministers) for decision in a period, whatever the outcome.
new_indicators.notes: Austria: 'Anträge gemäß § 10 Abs. 6 StbG im Ministerrat'. Distinct from applications filed with the Land authority (applications_received).

gaps: Austria: no official split of § 10(6) naturalisations by field; the Interior Ministry says no statistics by ground (science, economy, sport, art) are kept, so the number of investor or business cases is unknown. Statistik Austria shows no figure ('-') for 2012 and 2013, and no figures for 2024-2025 were found.

Austria: there is no published price or investment threshold; amounts quoted by migration agents were not collected because they are not official. The names and professions published by the Federal Chancellery and in Council of Ministers minutes since 2016-2017 were not compiled.

Austria: cabinet confirmations and Land submissions were found only for 2005-2009 (4341/AB); rejections only as a second-hand figure (Addendum via Forum Informationsfreiheit: 177 for 2006-2017). Addendum's original 2018 research was not read.

North Macedonia: no official yearly series of economic-interest grants for 2005-2022, only the cumulative 121; no split by route (EUR 400,000 direct investment vs EUR 200,000 fund) or by nationality before 2023; no figures on the money invested.

North Macedonia: Commission documents disagree on the year of the single non-Turkish grant (2023 in COM(2025) 792 and SWD(2025) 429; 2025 in the 2025 enlargement report; 'no decisions' in 2023 in COM(2024) 571).

North Macedonia: the June 2026 draft amendments on ENER (ener.gov.mk timed out from here) and their parliamentary status could not be checked; the Fund for Innovation's rulebook and fee tariff (required by the 2021 decree amendment) were not found.

Cambodia: Sub-decree No. 112 ANKr.BK of 30 Aug 2018, which set the amounts between 2018 and 2025, was not found, so terms for 2018-2025 are missing. Press figures of 'just over $300,000' and 'around $245,000' appear to describe the 1996 riel amounts.

Cambodia: no official count of naturalisations by route (investment, donation, marriage, residence); all counts are journalists' tallies of the Royal Gazette covering all routes, and publication stopped in February 2024. No figures on money raised.
Cambodia: the 2018 law, the 2025 amendment and Sub-decree 225 are scanned Khmer PDFs without a text layer; quotes were transcribed by eye and the 2025 amendment was not read in detail.

Cambodia: no Al Jazeera investigation specifically on Cambodian passports was found. Al Jazeera's 2020 'Cyprus Papers' concern Cambodian elites buying Cypriot passports, a different issue; the OCCRP and Straits Times reporting is used instead.
